global_assertions: Fixture adapter is selected before existing screen effects schedule and feeds the same render tree; no early whole-screen return or replacement component is allowed.
After request interception is armed and fixture URL is mounted through history, every observed browser request fails and the final request counter equals zero.
After mount and every action: integer plan >= 0, 0 <= packed <= picked <= plan, remaining = plan - picked; auto-pass has a visible reason and picked = plan.
Return restock is disabled and rejected server-side until per-unit identity and condition inspection is complete and explicit restock disposition exists.
Every visible changed-zone control declares one action intent; the count for any zone plus intent is at most one.
Every geometry field present in BASELINE_GEOMETRY.json is not worsened; existing narrow overflow never increases.
With marketplace Wildberries and no fixture query, visible copy, action intents, enabled states, stage transitions, request method/path/payload snapshots and geometry equal baseline.
